title: ZnSe grown on carbon nanofibers derived from ZIF-8 as a zincophilic layer for zinc metal anodes
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE01371B, Paper
Yudong Feng, Zhaoli Liu, Yuying Zheng, Yuanpei Li, Xingwei Sun
The ZnSe/CNFs@Zn anode exhibits prolonged cycling stability, sustaining a stable cycle for over 1700 h at 1 mA cm−2 in symmetric batteries. When configured as batteries, ZnSe/CNFs@Zn‖V2O5 systems show stable cycling over 2000 cycles at 5 A g−1.
